dapps.name: minimaCore App Store
dapps.description: v0.3.1: our minimaCore node build now wears a glowing Recommended badge in the Android Apps tab, so it can't be confused with the plain upstream mirror. v0.3.0: the PandaApps makeover. Apps grouped by what they do (Get Started, Wallets, Finance & Trading, Games, Tools and more), an Updates section pinned to the top when anything you have installed is behind, and a full page per app with its description, version history, details and a link to its source code — across all four tabs. Native Android apps AND MiniDapps for Minima: one-tap install of MiniDapps from the PandaDapps and official Minima catalogs straight onto this node, the minimaCore node APK and every companion app for your phone, plus an IPFS Mirror tab that keeps working even if the store server is down.

dapps.name: Atelier
dapps.description: v4.4.8: FILTR on phones — all eight tool tabs (including Save/export) now fit on screen at once; the Save tab was scrolling off the right edge. (The native Atelier Android app adds a web-validation badge on every verified collection's image and a full StateNFT record view — see the APK.) v4.4.7: CRITICAL mint fix — collections that split-or-stamped but never confirmed on-chain now complete. Splitting and sealing an unstamped collection needs the creator's signature (the contract's creator-bypass); the engine signed with the wallet default only, so those transactions were silently dropped. Fixed end to end. Also removed a false 'too heavy — bury it' warning that could wrongly tell you to discard a mintable collection. FILTR on phones now fits the safe area, fills the width, taps the pad to import, and keeps the editing panes under the image (scroll/collapse). v4.4.0: FILTR phone redesign (Snapseed-style bottom-sheet) + HOSTING + web-validation that never blocks a mint — upload photos to your own storage (WebDAV / IPFS / GitHub, or a free Pinata key with no server) and auto-fill every hosted URL, verified before minting. v4.2.6: chosen icons honored + photos always fit (icon auto-slims instead of starving plate room; deeper shrink ladder) + mint engine truth fix — the engine trusts only chain-confirmed seals, self-heals collections falsely marked finished, and re-posts lost stamps duplicate-proof. v4.2.2: phone-friendly FILTR — the image stays pinned while editing panes flick from a bottom tab bar on narrow screens (desktop keeps the full editor); also restores the Filtr scripts missing from the 4.2.0/4.2.1 packages. The Minima NFT studio. StateNFT collections: 2–20 editions sharing one tokenid, each coin's identity sealed in state and locked by KISS VM contract — immutable even to the creator. Generative art studio with 18 on-chain SVG style packs (Mandala, Mondrian, Punks, Panda Punks…): deterministic from a seed, rarity sliders, per-item traits sealed into token metadata. Also mints single NFTs and custom tokens, sends whole collections via a background queue that survives the page closing, and buries unwanted collections at the provably unspendable graveyard address. Katalog design — every mint a numbered lot. Pairs with the native Atelier Android app: the same seed mints byte-identical art on either. Needs WRITE permission (it posts transactions). EXPERIMENTAL; test small.

dapps.name: AtomiX
dapps.description: Trustless cross-chain atomic swaps: MINIMA or MxUSD with Ethereum ERC20 USDT. Live order book, market-making, best-price sweeps, OTC deals and an ETH wallet. 0.1.26 adds stale-input validation, bounded wallet reads, confirmed Minima settlement tracking, failed-trade refund recovery and clearer leg diagnostics. Signing holds no longer expire by time alone, and malformed Ethereum replies are rejected. Interoperates with native AtomiX. Needs WRITE permission to derive keys and sign swaps. EXPERIMENTAL; test small.

dapps.name: PandaPools
dapps.description: v0.6.23: keeps unresolved owned pools visible, validates current reserve recovery, preserves backup recipes and pauses uncertain signing state. Keep a current complete wallet backup and pool recipe; recovery also needs available chain proofs. v0.6.22: real node-verified confirmation counts, receipt recovery, consistent transaction timestamps, and chronological wallet and public pool activity. Preserves original receipt IDs and failed records; incomplete lookups remain visible. Historical recovery requires retained node headers. Includes the live pool-coin refresh for Withdraw, Add and Migrate. Constant-product AMM: swap MINIMA/token, provide liquidity and earn the 0.5% swap fee. Shares live pools with the native app.

dapps.name: PandaDEX
dapps.description: On-chain order-book DEX for MINIMA/mxUSDT, blended with PandaPools AMM reserves. Every order is a V5 covenant coin holding your own funds — no custodian, and no server can touch or erase them. Place a limit order, sweep several resting orders in one transaction at the best available price, or fill atomically across book and pool together; any unfilled balance rests as a limit order. Includes a full market-making ladder, a funding split so a ladder is not serialised behind one wallet coin, a candle chart, your own confirmed trades kept separate from the market tape, and a trade export with on-chain evidence and reconciliation CSVs. Shares its order book with the native PandaDEX Android app — parity with native 0.3.9. v0.4.6: a sale's proceeds were reported unconfirmed for as long as the page stayed open — the balance was re-read only when a coin was created or spent, and a coin becomes confirmed simply by the chain moving on, which emits nothing. It is now re-read every block, as the native app does. v0.4.5: the export now leaves as ONE pandadex-trades-<date>.zip instead of four separate downloads — the reconciliation CSV means nothing without the summary stating the window, wallet and balances it reconciles against. v0.4.4: the ASSETS card labelled money "Confirming" when it was actually LOCKED (confirmed but unspendable, so waiting never released it), and never read the node's real unconfirmed figure at all; sendable, confirmed, locked and unconfirmed are now four separate figures plus the coin count, as the native app shows them. v0.4.3: restores the transaction-size check native runs before posting. v0.4.2: a locked node vault now says so instead of surfacing a raw node error. v0.4.0: a fill is verified against the transaction that actually spent the order coin, so a fill whose proceeds were already spent onward is no longer lost, and a cancelled order can no longer be counted as a phantom fill. v0.3.8: pool depth was overstated by roughly 2x and the app froze for up to a minute per block. v0.3.7: nothing could be signed or posted at all from 0.2.33 onward — the signing gate called setInterval, which does not exist in the MDS service runtime. Needs WRITE permission (it signs orders and takes) and an unlocked vault. Do NOT run the same seed on two nodes: each node keeps its own one-time-key counter, so both would hand out the same key leaf. EXPERIMENTAL and it moves real funds — test small.

Needs WRITE permission and an unlocked vault. Run it on the node that ran Maximize.

dapps.name: Future Cash
dapps.description: Lock payments to the future — with WOTS key-reuse protection: audits your node's keys, safely collects matured stakes, and moves any at-risk (key-reused) ones to a safe wallet. 3.2.0 fixes the audit getting in your way: if the audit service can't be reached, collecting now carries on — your last good result is re-confirmed against your own node's key counters, offline — instead of stopping dead on a network error. It also asks for the audit far less often. New: your safe destination is itself checked against the known-reuse database when you set it and on every audit, so rescued money is never swept onto another exposed key. Includes the important 3.1.21 fix (earlier versions could collect other people's stakes — update if you are on 3.1.20 or older). Full guide: minidapps.minima.global/futurecash/guide.html

dapps.name: Future Cash Classic
dapps.description: The original official Future Cash — lock up Minima for yourself or another and unlock it in the future. Keep this classic build to view and collect locks created with the original version (including old Maximize stakes).

dapps.name: Entropy
dapps.description: Provably fair BIP39 seed phrase generator — roll animated dice for maximum entropy. Each face = SHA3(node random ++ browser random), rejection-sampled to exact uniformity (the Zero Edge Casino resolve maths, run locally — nothing ever on-chain). The phrase is produced by the embedded, unmodified iancoleman/bip39 v0.4.3 code and re-derived by an independent engine — both must agree or nothing is shown. Physical-dice mode, per-roll audit log verifiable via runscript, Last Word checksum calculator (11/14/17/20/23 words in, every valid final word out) with 4-char autocomplete and hide/blur. READ permission only; nothing stored or transmitted — closing the dapp destroys the phrase.

dapps.name: Terminal IDE
dapps.description: v0.1.1: complete help for every command — every parameter and action value the node accepts is now in the autocomplete and in 'help command:x' (vault password:/confirm:/numkeys: and testphrase/resetkeys, peers url:, mds folder:/locationonly:/reload, full pages for sendfrom/createfrom/signfrom/txnauto…), because the node's own help leaves them out. A professional Minima terminal with IDE-grade autocomplete, run straight from your node. Autocomplete is mined from the node's own help pages (125 commands) and covers command names, per-command parameters (required first, already-used ones filtered out) and the allowed values of a parameter — e.g. type 'maxima action:' and pick from info/setname/hosts/send… Includes the FULL Maxima classic set (maxima, maxcontacts, maxextra, maxcreate, maxsign, maxverify) plus mds/checkpending/checkmode/checkrestore, and on start does a live help merge so it mirrors your exact node build (adds any command it doesn't know, refreshes descriptions, never hides one). Colorized JSON output with errors highlighted, click any past command to re-run or edit, persistent history with up/down arrows, and guards that warn before node-killers like an unbounded 'coins' or a huge 'history'/'printtree'. The web/MDS sibling of the native Terminal IDE Android app. READ permission is enough to explore; grant WRITE only if you intend to post transactions.
